result: Git reported CR characters as trailing whitespace in generated CSV evidence
root_cause: csv.DictWriter used its default RFC-style CRLF line terminator while the repository requires LF text evidence
resolution: preserve every pre-normalization CSV SHA-256, set the producer lineterminator explicitly to LF, normalize only line endings, refresh inventory hashes, and rerun all affected tests and evidence validation
